NgStep.description: A step of the handling of a request where a plugin runs: `Sink` (answers the requests no route matches), `PreRoute`, `ValidateAccess`, `TransformRequest`, `CallBackend`, `TransformResponse`, `MatchRoute` (decides whether a route matches), `Router`, `HandlesTunnel`, `HandlesRequest` (handles the whole request). `Job`, `DataExporterFilter` and `DataExporterTransform` are the steps of the plugins that are jobs or that filter and transform the events of the data exporters

PluginDescription.description: A plugin of the proxy engine that can be added to a route

id.description: The id of the plugin, to use as the `plugin` of a route plugin: `cp:` followed by the name of its class

name.description: The readable name of the plugin, the one the route designer of the backoffice shows and searches on

description.description: What the plugin does, `null` when it has no description
description.example: This plugin expects to find an apikey to allow the request to pass

default_config.description: The configuration the plugin uses by default, `null` when it has none

config_schema.description: The form that edits the configuration of the plugin in the backoffice: the form generated from its configuration class (see `GET /api/forms`), merged with the one the plugin declares. Empty when it has none

config_flow.description: The names of the fields of the configuration form, in the order the backoffice shows them

no_js_form.description: Whether the plugin has no form of its own in the javascript of the backoffice: the backoffice then edits its configuration with the form of `config_schema` and `config_flow`

plugin_type.description: The kind of plugin, always `ng` (a plugin of the proxy engine)

plugin_visibility.description: Who can use the plugin, always `userland` here: the internal plugins are left out

plugin_categories.description: The categories of the plugin, see `GET /api/plugins/categories`

plugin_steps.description: The steps of the handling of a request where the plugin runs (see `GET /api/plugins/steps`)

plugin_tags.description: Free tags the plugin declares, empty for the plugins shipped with otoroshi

plugin_multi_inst.description: Whether a route can hold the plugin several times

plugin_backend_call_delegates.description: Whether the plugin, when it calls the backend itself, can delegate the call to the usual backend call of otoroshi

on_request.description: Whether the plugin acts on the request on its way to the backend: a pre route, an access validator, a route matcher, a request sink, a tunnel handler, a transformer of the request, or a websocket plugin of the client messages

on_response.description: Whether the plugin acts on the response on its way back to the client: a transformer of the response or of the errors, a websocket plugin of the backend messages, or a plugin of another kind (a backend call for instance) than the ones that only act on the request

example.name: Apikeys
example.description: This plugin expects to find an apikey to allow the request to pass

Form.description: A form of the backoffice that edits a configuration class, generated from the openapi description of the class

schema.description: The fields of the form, by name

flow.description: The names of the fields, in the order the form shows them, the nested forms last

FormField.description: A field of a form of the backoffice

label.description: The label of the field, its name

type.description: The input that edits the field: `string`, `number`, `bool`, `array`, `object` (a map), `form` (a nested form, see `schema`), `select` (see `props.options`), `code` (a json editor), or `unknown type` when the type could not be guessed

props.description: The settings of a `select` or a `code` input: its label, the values a `select` offers, the language of a `code` editor and whether it only shows the editor

label.description: The label of the input, the name of the field

editorOnly.description: Whether a `code` input only shows the editor

collapsable.description: Whether a nested form can be collapsed

collapsed.description: Whether a nested form starts collapsed

array.description: Whether the field holds an array of values of its type

format.description: The format of the items of an array: `form` when they are objects (see `schema`), `null` otherwise

schema.description: The fields of a nested form, or of the items of an array of objects, by name

flow.description: The names of the fields of a nested form, or of the items of an array of objects, in the order the form shows them
